title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode2 Scheduling Revelations

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That was great!
You all sound so fired up today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that sounded very good...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our show today went better than expected and it feels like all our hard work is finally starting to pay off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we're practicing every day, and you're all starting to get used to performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's three times you praised us today, Shiho! I promise to keep doing my best♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I know we've come a long way, but at the same time, I know we still have a lot to work on and need to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want our next performance to resonate more with everyone who comes to see us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! It'd be amazing if we could play our second original song at our next show too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mean the song Ichika was writing lyrics for after our first show? Didn't you say that you were still working on the melody for it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Guess what...? Ta-daah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I came up with it after our show yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really...? Way to go, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hold on, all of this in one day?
You didn't pull an all-nighter, did you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
H-Hey, I'm being careful!
Hona told me the same thing yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It started with me wondering how some of my ideas would sound, and before I knew it, I ended up with a whole pile of them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's incredible, Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I just wanted to turn what I was feeling into music! Kinda like what Ichi said during our last show, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that's the case, then your music should go really well with my lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I hope so too...!
Mind if we listen to what you have, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, go for it!
Here, let's start with my first one♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So, what do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think I like your first one.
It suits my lyrics the most, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I felt the same way. You could tell how excited Saki was about coming up with it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Do we have a consensus?
Why don't we run with it? I have a feeling it'll do pretty well if we play it live.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song's turning out to be another good one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
I can't wait to play it for everyone during our next show!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But will we have enough time to practice before then...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
We need to learn our respective parts and put it all together during practice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We might not have enough time to polish it up for an actual show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've been playing mostly the same songs during our shows, so it would be nice to introduce a new one during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, everyone...
How would you feel about me putting together the schedule leading up to our next show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I remember most of what we did after our first song was finished, including how we practiced playing it for that show, so I think I can put one together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! You're the best, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that would be a huge help.
Mind handling all that then?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Just give me a little bit of time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we take a break while we wait?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go talk to Rin♪
She wanted me to recommend her some songs last time, so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, wait. Where's Rin?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I haven't seen her today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did she run off somewhere?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin's showing our newcomer around right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Newcomer?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, guys, I'm back☆
Oh, Ichi and the gang are here too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome back, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that means this is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So you're the ones who created this SEKAI. Nice to meet you. I'm Kagamine Len!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: L-Len...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's me. I joined Miku's band a little while back, and I'm really glad to be here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You came here after me, so that means you're my junior now, right♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hold on, Rin, that doesn't make any sense...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure it does!
So call me, “Senpai,” okay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on that logic, that means KAITO's also Rin's junior, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin's junior...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're still like a big brother to me, KAITO☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This place just keeps getting livelier and livelier.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, is it true that you've been playing in shows?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, but we're still very new to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were just talking about playing a new song during our next one too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you mean the song Ichi was writing lyrics for? It's already done?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not quite. It still needs to be polished.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. We'd like to have it ready in time for our next show, so we're having Honami see if that's possible based on our current schedule.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your schedule, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's really admirable of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No... It's nothing, really...
I just wanted to find a way to help out everyone a little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A little...?
It's pretty big if you ask me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, Rin would never be able to handle anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's that supposed to mean?! Why me?! You couldn't handle it either, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, will you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, here's the schedule I've come up with.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's the verdict?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... Today, we'll practice like normal, and if we really work on this song for an hour each day, we could conceivably be ready in three-days time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which would leave making adjustments during practice. Our last one took around two weeks, so I suspect this one will take just as long...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's so specific!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'd been playing everything by ear up until now, but having an actual schedule in front of us like this really tells us what we'll need to do by when...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
As long as we stick to this schedule...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Sorry, I have a meeting on Friday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll have to leave a little early whenever I have to go to work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll make those adjustments.
Just tell me about any other clashes if you think it's going to be an issue.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hona!
About this week...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, done...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I thought we'd be fine since our show isn't until next month, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: With all these clashes, it's going to be pretty tight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It'd be fine if we weren't working on a new song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I-Isn't there anything we can do about this?! I'll practice really hard on my own when I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate your concerns, but this schedule wouldn't mean anything if it becomes too unrealistic, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She's right...
There'd be no point in pushing ourselves too hard. We need to think about this based on what we have now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
B-But...
Does that mean we have to give up on our new song?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we've come this far, so it'd be nice to give the crowd something new...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wanna give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Shiho!
I promise to try extra super hard!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just not too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're so motivated now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We all want to see our new song become a reality and show everyone how fun it is to play music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Based on this schedule, it might be better for them to focus on practicing than selling tickets for our show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess I'll just have to take care of that...
